name: I Told My Mom Tee
note:
A black oversized tee with an understated plain front and a soft pink text graphic on the back. The contrasting lettering makes the rear print the main feature. Wear it with dark denim for a tonal outfit.

240 GSM, 100% super-combed cotton. Pre-shrunk and bio-washed, with a Lycra-ribbed neckline and double-stitched construction. Full-length, unisex oversized fit.
